text: Lars has moved to Utrecht with his partner. He's working remotely for the same insurance firm and says the commute to the sofa suits him.
Saskia's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is next Thursday at the crematorium on Hill Road. I should send a card before then.

Victor told me at lunch that his team is being restructured and three roles are at risk. He finds out on Friday whether his is one of them. He's trying to act calm but he's clearly rattled. His wife has just gone part time to look after their youngest, so the timing could hardly be worse. He asked me to keep it quiet in the office for now. I'll take him for a coffee on Monday whatever happens.
Yuki is from Sapporo originally, lives in Leith now, and teaches piano in the evenings. Two younger brothers, both still in Japan.
Amara and Kenji have split up after six years. She's staying in the flat for now. Don't forget to ask Amara over for dinner this weekend.
Call with the Okafor account went fine. Blessing Okafor wants the revised proposal by next Tuesday, and her finance director, Mr Hughes, will be joining the review on 2 November 2026.
Shira's grandmother died last week, aged ninety-four. Shira is flying to Tel Aviv tomorrow for the shiva and will be back the following Monday.
New manager starts Monday. Florin says she's very hands-on and used to run the Bristol office. Must clear my backlog before then.
Jada mentioned her uncle was made redundant from the steelworks after thirty years. The whole family is a bit shaken by it.
Rory's moving to Glasgow in March 2027 to be nearer his mum, who's not been well. He hasn't handed in notice yet.
Car insurance renewal is due by Friday. Get a few quotes first.
Aaliyah lives two doors down from her sister Asha. They both work at the hospital, Aaliyah in radiology and Asha on the children's ward.
Ignacio's farewell drinks were meant to be Thursday but they've been cancelled because half the team is off sick. Apparently they'll try again in a fortnight.
Patrick's dog Murphy was put to sleep this morning. He was fifteen. Patrick sounded wrecked on the phone. I'll text him tomorrow to see how he's holding up.

Amy and Callum are getting married on 12 June 2027 in Galway. Amy wants an outdoor ceremony; Callum's mum is apparently not thrilled about the weather risk. They've booked a hotel near Salthill for the reception and want the hen and stag dos sorted by Easter. Amy's best friend Aaliyah is maid of honour and is already planning something in Lisbon for April 2027. Amy hinted that a nice photo frame for the venue would go down well.
Alice from procurement is leaving at the end of the month. Kevin is taking over her suppliers, which he is not happy about.
Meera's husband Siddharth got the consultant post at St Mary's. She's really proud of him. Remind me to congratulate Sid when I see him on Wednesday.
Quick catch-up with Wiremu. He lives in Hamilton, works as a surveyor for the council, and has three kids, the youngest just turned two.
Nadia's mum's funeral was yesterday. I couldn't make it. I need to ring Nadia this evening and properly apologise, and maybe drop some food round on Saturday.

Noah called. His girlfriend ended things last night, out of nowhere. He's staying at his brother Mateo's for a few days. He said he's fine but he really isn't. They'd been together nearly four years and had just started looking at flats in Bristol. He's got a big pitch at work on Thursday and doesn't know how he's going to get through it.
Reggie has a Spurs season ticket and collects old matchday programmes.
Joseph from the Leeds client rang to say they're pausing the project until January 2027. Need to let Anders know before our Monday stand-up.
Tomás has been at the bank for eleven years and is now head of compliance. Married to Vanessa, who runs a bakery in Hove.
Lars and Saskia are hosting a memorial lunch for Saskia's father on Saturday 14 November 2026. Lars asked if we could bring a salad. Need to confirm with him by Wednesday.
Victor didn't lose his job in the end. He's moving across to the data team from next month. Relieved, but he'll miss his old manager.
Kenji's back at work after the breakup. Quieter than usual. His sister is visiting from Osaka next week, which should help.
Picked up Mum's prescription and dropped the parcel at the post office. Still need to sort the boiler service for next Thursday.
Yuki's cat Mochi went missing on Tuesday. She's put posters up all over Leith Walk. I should share her post on the neighbourhood group tonight.
Board presentation got moved to Thursday at ten. Amara is presenting the client numbers and is really nervous about it. Text her good luck on Wednesday night.
Blessing's brother Joseph lives in Lagos and works in shipping. Her parents are retired in Manchester.

Florin was made redundant today along with four others from the design team. He took it better than I expected, but he's worried about the mortgage. He's got a meeting with HR on Monday to go through the package, and his wife Jada is due back from her work trip on Sunday, so at least he won't be on his own all weekend. I'll message him on Tuesday to ask how the HR meeting went.
Uncle Patrick's knee replacement is booked for 3 December 2026. Aunt Shira is driving him in. I'm taking the dog for the week.
Asha said her ex has been in touch again since the breakup in August. She's not going to reply. Just keeping a note in case it comes up.
Rory says his manager, Mrs Walsh, is retiring in the spring after twenty-two years. The team is planning a send-off at the Crown on 26 March 2027.

Vanessa's grandad passed away over the weekend. She's taking compassionate leave until next Friday. Kevin is covering her accounts. I should sign the card in the office tomorrow. She was very close to him; he basically raised her while her mum worked nights. The funeral is on Wednesday 11 November 2026 in Derry and she's flying over on the Monday with her partner Joseph.
Alice Chen, or Ali as everyone calls her, is the new head of HR. Previously at a law firm in Canary Wharf. Lives in Greenwich with her wife and their twin boys.
Talked to Ignacio about the Gonzalez contract. The client keeps changing the brief and he's exhausted. He said his partner told him to start looking elsewhere.
Meera's daughter starts university in Edinburgh next September. Meera's already dreading the empty house.
Note to self: the team away day is Wednesday 18 November 2026, and I'm booking the train tickets for everyone tomorrow morning.

Callum's grandmother is in a hospice now and the family has been told it could be a matter of days. Callum is going up to Inverness tonight. Don't forget to tell his manager, Noah, that he'll be off for the rest of the week, and check in with Callum on Friday.

Wiremu and his wife are expecting their fourth in March 2027. He joked that they'll need a bigger car. Must get them something for the baby nearer the time. Their eldest, Rangi, is apparently desperate for a little sister, and his mum has already started knitting. Wiremu's taking two weeks' paternity leave and his boss is being good about it.
Saskia is going back to work on Monday. She says routine will help. Her brother Lars is staying with her mum for another week.
Victor's old boss, Mr Schmidt, has been let go after the merger. Nobody saw it coming. Victor seems a bit unsettled, wondering if more cuts are on the way.
Patrick lives in Cork, works for a medical devices company, and is a keen sea swimmer. Goes in every morning, even in January.

Long chat with Amara on the phone. The breakup with Kenji is properly final now; they've agreed she keeps the flat and he takes the car. She's been sleeping badly and has taken a few days off work, though she says her boss has been decent about it. Her sister is coming down from Leeds on Friday to stay for the weekend. Amara mentioned she'd love to get back into pottery, so a class voucher might be a nice thing for her birthday on 9 January.
Reggie's son Mateo has a trial with the county under-14s on Saturday. Reggie is more nervous than Mateo is.

Kevin's dad died very suddenly on Tuesday night. Heart attack. The funeral will probably be the week after next. I need to send flowers to his mum's house, and I'll ring Kevin at the weekend to see how he's coping.
Nadia mentioned she's been after a decent pair of walking boots since hers fell apart in the Lakes. Could be a good Christmas present.

Siddharth's company is relocating to Reading in the new year, so he and Meera are deciding whether to move or for him to commute. Lots to think about. Their son is in his GCSE year, so Meera really doesn't want to move him before his exams next summer. Sid is leaning towards renting a room in Reading Monday to Thursday. They're going to see a few places on Saturday.

Joseph Osei called. Their last round of interviews for the operations manager role is on 5 November 2026, and he wants me on the panel. Need to block out that afternoon and read the CVs over the weekend.
Feeling a bit flat today. Long week. Going to take Friday off and head up to the coast.
Anders works in Copenhagen during the week and flies home to Aberdeen at weekends. His wife, Saskia, is a GP there.
Tomás's leaving do was cancelled. He's no longer leaving, the bank offered him a counteroffer on Monday and he accepted. He's staying on as head of compliance and getting a team of four.
Jada asked me how Florin's interview went last Thursday. I don't know, I forgot to ask him. Should text him this afternoon.
Shira is back from Tel Aviv. She said the shiva was hard but it was good to be with her cousins. Her mum is going to stay with her for a while.
Aaliyah's ex-husband is remarrying next spring, and their kids will be page boys. She's being very gracious about it but I think it stings.
Amy is from Galway, lives in Dublin, and works in marketing for an airline. Her brother Rory is the one who moved to Glasgow.
Victor said the client dinner on Friday is off; the Hughes family had a bereavement. We'll reschedule for next month. Need to send a condolence note from the team.
Bins still not collected. Council says Tuesday, maybe.

Mateo's mum Vanessa told me he's been struggling since his grandfather's funeral in September and has started seeing a counsellor at school on Thursdays. She's worried but thinks it's helping. Should ask her how he's getting on next time we have coffee.
